bugs.error_message: Cards and stats are not vertically aligned
bugs.root_cause: Summary stat cards and summary list used different effective content widths, so rows did not align on the same vertical guides.
bugs.fix: Set .summary-body to align-items: stretch with max-width: 440px and made .summary-list width: 100% so cards and rows share the same layout width.

bugs.error_message: Participant names in summary should be left aligned
bugs.root_cause: Summary rows inherited centered text behavior from higher-level layout styles.
bugs.fix: Added `text-align: left` to `.summary-name` so participant names align to the left edge of their column.

bugs.error_message: Progress bars should take all available horizontal space
bugs.root_cause: Summary container and stat row were constrained to a 440px max width, reducing bar lane width on larger available space.
bugs.fix: Removed max-width constraints from `.summary-body` and `.summary-stats`, allowing summary rows and bars to stretch to the full available content width.
